articles.title: Denise Salazar, 82, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Denise Salazar for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Mill Hill Lions Club in his or her name. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Denise Salazar spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Denise Salazar died in August at home on Adams Court, at the age of 82. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood.
